commit.message:
feat(ui): Machines pane creates, edits and saves .mch machine files

The Machines pane gains New blank (per kind), New from template and
Edit machine. A machine file opens as a property grid in collapsible
groups (axes and travels, rotaries and limits, spindle range, feeds,
tool changer and stations, coolant codes, live-tool codes, units), each
field's key in its tooltip and its validation refusals under it. Save
and Save As write to the user machines folder (CAMCRAFT_MACHINES, else
<platform data dir>/camcraft/machines) through a temp file and a
rename, each asking first; any refusal blocks both. Shipped machines
are read-only (Save becomes Save As). Edits go to the file's raw JSON,
so unknown keys in a hand-written file are written back. The pane's
catalogue lists the user folder.

App: machine::store (folder resolution, atomic validated write),
machine::fields (grid + pointer edit), machine::draft (open, template,
blank, save, save as); library::enumerate_with / text_of.
Not a command: a machine FILE save touches no document or history.

Fixes #383
